title: Virial Cosmological Model
content: Since its formal discovery in the late nineties of the last century, the accelerating inflation of the universe became the focus of attention of astronomers as they tried to explain this mysterious phenomena and the driving force behind it.The accelerating inflation of the Universe is inferred directly from the observations of  type Ia supernova (SN Ia), which act as "standard candles" to measure vast cosmic distances.Due to its role in accelerating inflation, and the estimate of its contribution to the total energy density to be about two-thirds, scientists developed of various theoretical models for the dark energy which went through various stages, from the cosmological constant to time varying dynamic models that are trying to address the latest observational findings with hints to its weakening effect over time.
